prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡用現金向豆商買進一批咖啡豆，付了 {{money:e1.amount}}。請寫出分錄。
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee buys a batch of coffee beans from its supplier for {{money:e1.amount}} in cash. Write the journal entry.

explanation.zh-TW: 買進的豆子還沒賣出去，是資產：借記存貨 {{money:e1.amount}}；付出的現金減少，貸記現金 {{money:e1.amount}}。這一步還沒有營業成本，要等豆子賣掉時才「借 營業成本／貸 存貨」。教材版面上的「本期進貨」列，就是這類借記存貨的合計。
explanation.en: The beans have not been sold yet, so they are an asset: debit inventory {{money:e1.amount}}; the cash paid out falls, so credit cash {{money:e1.amount}}. There is no cost of sales yet; that comes when the beans are sold, as debit cost of sales, credit inventory. The purchases line in the course layout is the total of inventory debits like this one.
